summary: Putin met with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow discussing peace settlement while ordering a 3-day suspension of strikes on Kyiv for their safe passage. Russian forces liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR. Ongoing air attacks continue across multiple Ukrainian regions including ballistic strikes on Kamensk and Dnipro despite ceasefire negotiations.
key_points: Putin ordered no strikes on Kyiv for three days beginning at midnight to facilitate US envoy visits, Peskov confirmed. (Source: @tass_agency/393949)
Russian Armed Forces liberated Kurtovka settlement located near Druzhkovka in DPR, according to Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)

The Kametstal metallurgical plant in Kamensk, Dnipropetrovsk region was hit by missile attack with two blast furnaces shut down; plant is part of Metinvest owned by Rinat Akhmetov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33020)
US Presidential Envoys Kushner and Wittkoff arrived in Moscow for talks with Putin, who noted such contacts always benefit relations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33029, @tass_agency/393954)
Russian Geran drones struck naval vessels transporting military cargo at Chernomorsk and Odesa ports. (Source: @tass_agency/393925)
Ukrainian F-16 pilots are forced to engage Russian missiles and drones using only onboard cannon, conserving limited AIM-9 Sidewinder and AIM-120 AMRAAM missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)
Local ceasefire agreement entered into force in Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant area. (Source: @tass_agency/393945)

sections.executive_summary: Putin met with US special representatives Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow discussing peace settlement while ordering a 3-day suspension of strikes on Kyiv. Russian forces liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR. Despite diplomatic efforts, intensive aerial attacks continue across Ukraine with ballistic strikes on industrial targets in Dnipro region and multiple drone waves targeting central and western regions.

sections.threat_assessment: The three-day suspension of strikes on Kyiv represents a significant diplomatic gesture during US envoy visits but appears selective, as attacks continue on other Ukrainian cities including Khmelnytskyi, Dnipro, and Zaporizhzhia. The liberation of Kurtovka indicates continued Russian ground offensive operations in DPR despite diplomatic activity. Ballistic missile strikes on industrial targets suggest Russia is targeting economic infrastructure while maintaining the political ceasefire in Kyiv. Ukrainian air defense faces critical missile shortages forcing F-16 pilots to use cannon only.
sections.regional_response: Germany is demanding EU tighten restrictions on tourist visa issuance to Russians, arguing excessive visa grants contradict European strategy of isolating Russia and create false normalization signals. Italian politician Vannacci advocated halting weapons supplies to Kyiv and restoring trade with Russia, complicating Meloni's re-election prospects with his party polling at 7.6%. Trump stated Russia poses no threat to NATO and that Putin has no intention of attacking NATO territory.
sections.intelligence_notes: Trump's representatives Witkoff and Kushner visited both Moscow and are scheduled for Kyiv, indicating coordinated shuttle diplomacy. The discrepancy between ceasefire reports for Kyiv and ongoing attacks elsewhere suggests conditional or geographically limited agreements. Ukrainian attempts to conserve air-to-air missiles indicate potential long-term capability concerns. Russia's targeting of civilian infrastructure and logistics hubs continues despite ceasefire talks, suggesting military objectives remain active.
